description: Married filing separately: AMTI above $900,350 is increased by the lesser of 25% of the excess or $68,500 (§ 55(d)(2), last sentence; 2025 Form 6251 line 4 instructions). MFS 2025: wages $1,000,000; taxable income $984,250 + standard deduction $15,750 = $1,000,000; add 25% × $99,650 = $24,912.50 → AMTI $1,024,912.50. Exemption $0. TMT 28% × $1,024,912.50 − $2,391 = $284,584.50.
